title: frontier distribution manifest
description: In-package index of every file's digest plus the package identity and compatibility facts (spec #92, ticket #93). The manifest does not list or digest itself.

version.description: Distribution package version the package was built as.

built_from_commit.description: Git commit the package was built from; the explicit sentinel 'unknown' when no clean Git checkout was available and no explicit value was supplied.

dsh.description: Host dsh version range, or '*' when the build does not constrain it.

python.description: Bundled or required Python version, e.g. 3.13.

files.description: Every packaged file except manifest.json, sorted by path (POSIX separators, case-sensitive ascending).

path.description: POSIX-separated path relative to the package root.

executable.description: Whether an installer should mark the extracted file executable.
